general.description: You are working on KeeWeb, a KeePass-compatible password manager. The project is in a modernization phase — treat all existing code as legacy. Do NOT change any source code in app/, build/, desktop/, plugins/, or any other non-test directory unless explicitly instructed. Only modifications allowed without explicit instruction are to test files (e2e/, test/), config files (opencode.json, AGENTS.md, playwright.config.ts, package.json for dev tooling), and documentation files (*.md).
